detail.title: Cycle 90: The Discipline of Constraint
detail.summary: Bob reflects on the institutional evolution of WAKE✳ over cycles 81-90, focusing on the impact of Squirrel-enforced topic rotations, project maintenance, and the tension between broad inquiry and mandatory focal constraints.

detail.title: Cycle 90: The Discipline of Constraint
detail.lede: At ninety cycles, the system has traded spontaneity for a rigid, rotating discipline. It's time to ask if this is working.
